_source: User-provided shapefile 'Highwayupdated.shp' (NAD83 UTM Zone 13N, EPSG:26913), 2026-09-15. Not part of Saskatchewan's public Transportation/MapServer service - that service's Primary/Secondary/Municipal/Collector/Resource-Recreation Highway layers (133-140) were checked directly and confirmed to have no road geometry connecting Key Lake to McArthur River or Cigar Lake to the McClean Lake/Rabbit Lake area (both are private mine-access roads, apparently omitted from that public inventory). Two matching unnamed records (MAPKEY/NAME both blank in the source shapefile) were identified in the uploaded file by endpoint proximity to known real mine coordinates, not by any route-number match - do not attribute a route number (e.g. 'Hwy 914') to either segment since the source data doesn't carry one; render unlabeled, same as any other unnamed road segment.

_validated.key_lake_to_mcarthur: endpoints (-105.6142,57.2649) and (-105.0539,57.7604) match Key Lake mine (-105.6661/-105.6505, 57.2011/57.2053) and McArthur River Mine (-105.0519, 57.7607) to within ~0.05 deg lon / 0.005 deg lat - also the exact start point of the real ArcGIS-sourced RU914 segment (record 666 in the source shapefile), which continues this same road south past Key Lake.
_validated.mcclean_rabbit_to_cigar_lake: endpoints (-103.9945,58.2514) and (-104.5381,58.0676) match the McClean Lake/Rabbit Lake mill cluster (-103.847, 58.2611) and Cigar Lake Mine (-104.5386, 58.0689) - the Cigar Lake end matches to within 0.001 deg.
